notes.title: New Patch & Team Fortress 2 and Disgaea PC Team up With New Cosmetic Items!
notes.notes:
[img]http://nisamerica.com/img/TF2_DPC_MDLS.jpg[/img]

Hi Everyone,

First off, we want to give a huge thank you to our community. You have all been wonderful and extremely helpful. Thank you for making our experience on Steam awesome!

This week, we have updated [i]Disgaea PC[/i] with some fixes and tweaks, both major and minor. We know that our launch was a little rocky, but the devs have been working hard to address all of your concerns. The newest build of [i]Disgaea PC[/i] represents months of feedback from the community, support, and work from our developers.

It's Prinny fantastic, so check it out, dood!

Also, we're happy to announce our partnership with Valve® and the [i]Team Fortress 2[/i] team in releasing three brand-spanking new [i]Disgaea[/i]®-themed [i]Team Fortress 2[/i] cosmetic Items that will be compatible with all nine beloved [i]Team Fortress 2[/i] classes:
[list]
[*]Prinny Hat - The preferred headwear of all Prinny aficionados. Keeps your head warm and toasty while displaying your fandom for all to see.

[*]Prinny Pouch - The official pouch issued to all Prinnies. Hide your coins, hide your knives.

[*]Prinny Knife - The official knife issued to all Prinnies. It’s good for slashing, stabbing, and raising HL.
[/list]
Customers who already purchased [i]Disgaea PC[/i] will receive the genuine [i]Disgaea[/i]-themed cosmetic items soon and they will be available for new customers who purchase [i]Disgaea PC[/i] by the end of the Steam® Summer Sale.

Stay awesome, dood.

Best,
NISA Team

[b]UPDATE 7/29:[/b]
We have some news, doods! These items will now be available in Genuine quality for anyone who purchases [i]Disgaea PC[/i]! But, the Stock quality version of these items will also be available in the Mann Co. store! Prinny hats for all, dood!

notes.title: Disgaea PC – OST Update & Beta Branch
notes.notes:
[img=http://nisamerica.com/img/DisgaeaPC_capsule_lg_OST.jpg]

Hi Everyone,

We’re happy to announce the 10 remastered tracks for [i]Disgaea PC[/i] are now live and available for those who pre-purchased the [i]Disgaea PC[/i]: Digital Deluxe Dood Edition! The tracks are remastered and mixed by composer Tenpei Sato. Check ‘em out below!

1 - ラハール様の賛美歌 - Ode to Laharl
2 - 魔界の囁き - Dark Whisper
3 - 華麗なる闇族 - Elegant Demons
4 - AKUMA Drops
5 - がんばれ女の子 - Go Little Girl!
6 - Running Fire
7 - 赤い月 - Red Moon
8 - Hystelic Kingdom
9 - Planet X
10 - 幸せの花～ヘンボゲコット - Flower of Happiness: haengbokui ggot

Here is how to access the OST in Steam:
Open Steam > View > Music Details > soundtrack > Disgaea PC

A lot of topics within the [i]Disgaea PC[/i] Community Hub have mentioned the idea of beta testing patches and the possibility of having the community play the patch before its launch. Well, we got some good news for you, dood! We have created a beta branch sub forum for the [i]Disgaea PC[/i] community entitled [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/405900/discussions/5/]“Beta Branch”[/url] for people to test our upcoming patches! Click [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/405900/discussions/5/392184522704115565/]here[/url] for your chance to test Beta Patch 03/23/16! This beta will only be available for a limited time, so please head to the discussion page for more details.

Please stay tuned for further announcements in the future, dood!

Best,
Robbie

notes.title: Disgaea PC - Patch (03-16-16) Announcement
notes.notes:
[img=http://nisamerica.com/img/Dis_logo_PC.png]

Hi Everyone,

We are here for a [i]Disgaea PC[/i] patch update (3/16/16)! Our dev team has addressed the following issues:
[olist][*] Now fully compatible with Steam Controller
[*] Memory leak freezes (Cave of Ordeals 3, Item World and extended play times) have been addressed
[/olist]
After the patch was released this morning, we've seen the following reports:
[olist][*] Xbox Controller analog stick does not move freely during battle
[*] Xbox Controller users cannot move diagonally
[*] Crashes are still occurring
[*] The d-pad and analog stick now have the same movement speed
[*] The movement speed inside the castle has slowed down
[*] Deleting “pad.cfg” for improved gamepad performance
[/olist]

If there are still issues not mentioned in this announcement, please head over to the Troubleshooting sub forum titled [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/405900/discussions/3/412448158147364362/]“Bug Reports.”[/url] We know that this patch release did not address all issues, but again, we are continually in talks with our dev team to make sure that the [i]Disgaea PC[/i] community’s inquiries are answered and fixed. Thank you for your time and support!

Best,
Robbie

notes.title: Disgaea Levels Up With A New Patch
notes.notes:
If you’ve played Disgaea [official site], you know how it goes. You can enter the world of any item, fight in the randomly-generated dungeon you will find in it, and if you come out victorious not only you will gain experience points for yourself, but you’ll level up the item as well. Then again, if you’ve purchased Disgaea on PC, maybe you don’t know how it goes. The game’s launch has been plagued by all kinds of technical problems.

Developers NIS have quickly assembled a diligent team of penguins and sent them to explore the inner worlds of their own game code. After clearing thousands of floors, piling up in pointless penguin towers and dealing billions of points in damage to the various monsters and creatures they found in it, the code leveled up! And so, a week after launch, a pretty substantial patch has arrived to a fair share of the problems.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Disgaea PC - Patch (03-02-16) Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]http://nisamerica.com/img/Dis_logo_PC.png[/img]

Hi Everyone!

[b]UPDATE: 3/3/16[/b]
[list][*]Steam Overlay bug [b]*FIXED*[/b]
[*]"Cave of Ordeal 3" freeze bug [b]*FIXED*[/b]
[*]When saving on an existing save data, the save data doesn't save at the selected slot, but creates a new save [b]*FIXED*[/b]
[olist]- This is most likely occurred because the cursor was off and not responsive to the selected location.[/olist]
[*]New interface stats display bug [b]*FIXED*[/b]
[*]When reaching 100 save datas, game freezes [b]*FIXED*[/b]
[/list]
The [b]patch (03-02-16)[/b] officially launched this morning at 10:00 A.M. PST. Before we address issues that people are currently experiencing, we want to point out the specific fixes mentioned in our last announcement that our dev team was able to implement as shown below:
[list][*][b]1.) Maintaining controllability during framerate drops[/b]
a. When framerate drops, the game will skip frames, allowing users to maintain control.
[*][b]2.) Adding a warning message when turning on SSAO [/b]
a. There will be a warning message for users who turn on SSAO when using a PC below minimum recommended specs.
[*][b]3.) Fixing controller issues [/b]
a. Prior to the patch, the game would continuously search for a controller, which caused lower FPS rates. We have lowered the amount of times this occurs during in-game, so mouse/keyboard users should have better FPS rates.
[*][b]4.) Optimizing GPU performance [/b]
a. Devs were able to optimize the GPU performance, which in turn, should perform well for many PCs.
[*][b]5.) Low FPS on high-end PCs [/b]
a. We have fixed the problem where the game utilized only one core. This game should now properly utilize more than one core when available.
b. Fixed slowdowns when moving between maps.
c. Included CPU optimization (This option may lower performance depending on PC specs, so this will be a selectable option in the menu).
[*][b]6.) SSAO issues that occur regardless of PC specs [/b]
a. Fixed the issue in which turning on SSAO would create artifacts on screen.
b. Fixed the issue in which SSAO causes the screen to go black on PCS with Intel GPUs.
[*][b]7.) Other fixes[/b]
a. When playing the game on a PC below minimum specs, a warning message will appear.
b. Fixed some minor issues such as monster cries and text issues.
[/list]
[b]Additional Information:[/b]
[list][*]Customers using Windows 7 with an Intel® CPU and integrated graphics with outdated drivers:
This will cause a memory leak, causing the game to eventually crash. Please make sure to download and update your drivers at Intel’s website. [url=http://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support/detect.html?iid=dc_iduu]This link[/url] directs you to the Intel® Driver Update Utility, which will scan your computer and check for possible updates.
[*]As mentioned on the previous post, opting out of the “Steam Client Beta Participation” will fix FPS issue. If you are not aware about this issue, please click on [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/405900/discussions/0/412448158148686380/]here[/url] for step by step instructions on how to disable the “Steam Client Beta Participation.”
[*]We are aware that this patch has disabled the Steam overlay and is causing issues with in-home streaming and screenshots. We are working on a solution to this.
[*]Lastly, we are aware that people are having issues entering “Cave of Ordeals 3” as it crashes upon loading. We will send this to our dev team right away to get this fixed, so please stay tuned for further updates.
[/list]
We are extremely grateful for the support of the [i]Disgaea PC[/i] community and we hope to continue to reach out to the community to get more issues fixed. Though the launch of this patch may alleviate some major issues the community is experiencing, we are aware that there are other issues that need to be addressed and hope to see to them in future patches. We are dedicated to bringing you the best possible experience on Steam, so thanks again for everyone’s time and support!

Best,
Robbie

notes.title: Disgaea PC - Update (Day 3)
notes.notes:
[img]http://nisamerica.com/img/Disgaea_PC_Capsule.jpg[/img]
Greetings Everyone!

Welcome to another update for [i]Disgaea PC[/i]! Again, we want to make sure that the [i]Disgaea PC[/i] community is being heard, so we will continue  to post announcements regarding updates and concerns that the community has mentioned. We're reading all the threads and appreciate your feedback, but [b]please remember to keep threads on topic and treat others with respect. I will proceed to take action if necessary.[/b]

We are [b]planning on releasing an update by March 2nd.[/b] The release date for this update is subject to change, but we’ll definitely announce any changes through our announcements.

According to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/405900/discussions/0/412448158148686380/]thread posted by LordCastellian[/url], a good handful of [i]Disgaea PC[/i] users were able to fix the FPS drops. While this may be a temporary fix for some, we understand that this may not be the most viable option for everyone as it does not guarantee a better FPS rate. We are still researching this issue and added this to our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/405900/discussions/0/412448158147437177/]FAQ thread[/url] as a temporary FPS rate fix.

[u]Currently, our development team is looking into these five issues:[/u]
[list][*][b]1.) FPS is low even on high-end PCs[/b]
[*][b]2.) Maintaining controllability during slowdowns[/b]
[*][b]3.) SSAO issues[/b]
[*][b]4.) Performance changes when a controller/gamepad is detected[/b]
[*][b]5.) Increasing GPU usage[/b]
[/list]
[u]For the March 2nd update, we are planning on addressing the following:[/u]
[list][*][b]Maintaining controllability during framerate drops[/b]
[*][b]Adding a warning message when turning SSAO on[/b]
[*][b]Fixing controller issues[/b]
[*][b]Optimizing GPU performance[/b]
[/list]
[u]Things we are currently working on to be addressed in a later update:[/u]
[list][*][b]Low FPS on high-end PCs[/b]
[*][b]SSAO issues that occur regardless of PC specs[/b]
[/list]
[u]Details on the 5 issues below:[/u]
[list][*][b]1.) FPS is low even on high-end PCs[/b]
This is one of our biggest concerns at the moment, as it has become a common topic within the [i]Disgaea PC[/i] community.  We were not aware of this issue during testing, and were only made aware of it through user feedback. Our devs have noted this issue on their end and are working hard to address this in future updates. Please note that this issue is ongoing and it may take a little more time to address and pinpoint exactly what is causing this issue. We apologize for this unforeseen complication and are doing everything in our power to create a fix.
[*][b]2.) Maintaining controllability during slowdowns[/b]
This issue is related to issue 1, and we are looking into minimizing the stress caused by this issue. Our plan for addressing this problem is to allow the game to skip frames when slowdowns occur to maintain controllability of the game.
[*][b]3.) SSAO issues[/b]
This is an issue that is happening mostly on PCs with integrated graphics. For the update, we will include a message when a user tries to turn SSAO on with a computer that doesn’t have the required specs to run the game.
[*][b]4.) Performance changes when a controller/gamepad is detected[/b]
We plan to improve performance on many PCs that are experiencing framerate drops when a controller is not plugged in. 
[*][b]5.) Increasing GPU usage[/b]
We are looking into increasing performance on GPUs. We plan to look into this issue extensively and release gradual performance updates. 
[/list]
There have been a lot of changes within the past three days and I’m sure it has been an emotional roller coaster for many people, but again, we want to stress that our community is extremely important to us. Our company strives to continue to bring awesome titles to Steam and we hope for more great titles to come.

Thanks for your time, patience and understanding, dood! Have a great weekend!

Best, 
Robbie

We are looking into increasing performance on GPUs. We plan to look into this issue extensively and release gradual performance updates. 
[/list]
There have been a lot of changes within the past three days and I’m sure it has been an emotional roller coaster for many people, but again, we want to stress that our community is extremely important to us. Our company strives to continue to bring awesome titles to Steam and we hope for more great titles to come.

Thanks for your time, patience and understanding, dood! Have a great weekend!

Best, 
Robbie

notes.title: Disgaea PC: Launch Day Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://nisamerica.com/img/Disgaea_PC_Capsule.jpg[/img]

Hello Prinnies!

Thank you for checking out [i]Disgaea PC[/i]!

We spent a total of ten months on researching and developing this game for PC users, two months of which were spent on rigorous testing. However, we have been made aware of the fact that some of our customers have been experiencing issues when playing the game.

According to the research we have done, it seems as if most of the issues are graphics related.

Right now, we at NISA and NIS are trying to gather as much information from all over the world as possible in order to pinpoint what is causing these problems.

[b]Please use the comment section below and let us know what issues you are experiencing.[/b]

If you could [b]provide your computer specs, and specific details of where and when the bug occurs[/b], we can have a better understanding in pinpointing the issue.

We will do our absolute best to fix these issues as quickly as possible, and we will make sure that all your voices are heard by the dev team.

Thank you for your understanding.

NIS America Steam Team

notes.title: Disgaea PC: Digital Soundtrack Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://nisamerica.com/img/DisgaeaPC_header_OST.jpg[/img]

Hi Everyone!

Firstly, we would like to say thanks for everyone’s welcoming comments of our upcoming release of [i]Disgaea PC[/i]. It is great to see fans genuinely excited for the launch of the very first [i]Disgaea[/i] title on PC and we could not have done it without your support.

Unfortunately, we have some bad news regarding the [i]Disgaea PC[/i]: Digital Soundtrack. Due to previously unforeseen licensing restrictions, we are unable to provide the complete [i]Disgaea PC[/i]: Digital Soundtrack as originally advertised. We know this is disappointing news, and we’ll be doing our best to keep you updated with any and all changes as we finalize things. The changes that we can tell you about right now are:
[list]
[*]The soundtrack will [b]contain 10 remastered songs instead of the originally stated 32 original songs.[/b]
[*]The Disgaea PC: Digital Soundtrack will [b]only be available during the pre-purchase period.[/b]
[*]The [b]track list has not been finalized, but we will post an announcement once that information is final.[/b]
[*]The [b]tracks that were pre-purchased will be made available for download after the launch date of February 24.[/b] This is because the [b]remastering is planned to be completed in March.[/b]
[/list]
We apologize for this oversight and we will continue to do our best in this brave new PC world to provide quality products and learn as we go along. We know this change may make a big difference for some of you in purchasing [i]Disgaea PC[/i]: Digital Deluxe Dood Edition, so please be aware that full refunds for the product can still be initiated through Steam.

Again, thank you for everyone's support with our upcoming release of [i]Disgaea PC[/i] and we hope to bring more awesome titles on Steam in the near future!

Best,

Robbie
